name: Tool unification + the exercise program -- per-tool failure-mode truth established by EXERCISE, not declaration
description: RETROACTIVE REGISTRY CARRIER for the second-largest body of work in the tool program (mission-register INFRASTRUCTURE.TOOLS hole #1: 109 commits, 18 code files, 113 doc files, NO project JSON -- positive-controlled against NFRA_TOOLARCH.json). The work exists and much is COMPLETE; this carrier makes it attributable and pins what remains. THE PROGRAM (synthesis: org/tier1_exec/1.0.0_SA_CTO/deliverables/NFRA_TOOLUNIFY_CENSUS/SYNTHESIS.md, ~70 deliverables beside it): all 92 tool-register rows dispatched across 7 exercise passes, every row carrying an exercised verdict or an explicit honest non-verdict, zero silent drops, per-lane denominators printed. THE HEADLINE FINDING (CVO~Z-adopted): the register's failure_mode column is wrong in BOTH directions -- under-declared (declared-LOUD tools that fail open on wholly-absent inputs: 8 instances banked) AND over-declared (declared-FAIL-OPEN tools genuinely loud: B-batch understates tool quality 4:1) -- bidirectional error is NOISE not bias, so no global correction exists and the honest register shape is PER-ROW VERIFICATION PROVENANCE (exercised / source-read / rule-derived / default). BANKED PATTERN AXES: 2b disclosure is a 3-point scale (the dangerous cell = number-present-but-unflagged, a plausible wrong number beats a crash); 2c scope-coercion is its own axis (a filter silently ignored answers a question that was not asked); 2e call-site audibility != tool failure mode (a LOUD tool backgrounded+discarded by its one call site is operationally silent). ALSO UNDER THIS CARRIER: the MSYS argv-guard class (msys_argv_guard.py, the 5-member native-parent/POSIX-child class), the GRAPHUNI arc, and the toolpass fixes the census drove.

hazards: Do not quote program-level counts from any per-lane deliverable or commit message -- the synthesis's own rule: program counts appear ONLY in SYNTHESIS.md, and its superseded '5 instances' commit-message count is the recorded counterexample.

A MED-confidence FAIL-OPEN register row's more likely error is the ROW, not the tool (2d) -- readers must distrust unexercised declarations before distrusting tools; inverting this burns real tool quality on register noise.
A drifting live denominator is a FEATURE (the tool counts the real working set each run); only a FROZEN denominator is suspect. Naive readers misflag exactly this.
